title: Graphic texts: purpose and audience
canonical_examples_source: Language rules self-verified; format ref: bank uk-ks2-2024-gps (KS2 GPS).

blocks.content: Every poster, advert or sign is made for a reason and aimed at particular people. Knowing the purpose and audience helps you read a graphic text wisely.
A media text's purpose is usually to inform, to persuade, or to entertain.

steps: A safety sign giving a rule → to inform.
An advert selling sneakers → to persuade.
A funny comic strip → to entertain.

blocks.question: A billboard that says 'Buy now — half price today!' has what main purpose?
blocks.explain: It is pushing you to buy, so its purpose is to persuade.
blocks.rule: A media text's purpose is to inform, to persuade, or to entertain.

practiceItems.prompt: an advert's main purpose is usually to ___
a safety sign's purpose is to ___
a funny comic's purpose is to ___
the reason a text is made is its ___

blocks.content: The audience is the group of people a media text is aimed at.

blocks.question: A cereal advert full of cartoon characters and bright colours is aimed at which audience?
blocks.explain: Cartoons and bright colours are chosen to appeal to children — the target audience.
blocks.rule: The audience is the group of people a media text is aimed at.

practiceItems.prompt: who a media text is aimed at is its ___
cartoon characters aim a text at ___
a text that only gives facts aims to ___
an advert tries to change the audience's ___ (mind/height)

blocks.question: A bright advert for a new toy is full of cartoons and playful colours. Who is the intended audience, and how can you tell?
options: Children — the cartoons and bright colours are aimed at them
blocks.explain: The audience is who the text is made for. Cartoons and playful colours appeal to children, so children are the intended audience. Design choices are clues to the audience and purpose.
blocks.rule: Design choices reveal the intended audience and purpose.
blocks.principle: Media makers shape design to fit a target audience.
canonical_solution: The advert uses cartoons and bright colours

rubric.look_for: reads the design choices as clues

misconceptions.coach: Cartoons and playful colours target children.
The look of the advert points to its audience.

blocks.content: Ask why a graphic text was made and who it is for. Purpose and audience unlock its meaning. Let's practise!
